election_positions.description: Presidential position presiding over General Student Council and Senate meetings.
Chief administrator of Student Activities, Clubs, and Inter-College delegations.
Departmental student voice for academic lab resources and timetable coordination.
Coordinator for athletic meets and varsity tournaments.
Supreme representative for general student body in university senate.

candidate_applications.biography: Senior CSE student, Lead Organizer of College Hackathon 2025, passionate about student lab resources and 24/7 library access.
candidate_applications.manifesto:
1. 24/7 Library and high-speed campus Wi-Fi infrastructure.
2. Subsidized technical certifications and AI workshops.
3. Transparent grievance redressal portal with 48-hour resolution SLA.
4. Clean and hygienic cafeteria food quality audit committee.

candidate_applications.biography: Final year ECE student, Class Representative for 2 consecutive years, IEEE Student Branch Secretary.
candidate_applications.manifesto:
1. Merit-based student innovation funding pool of Rs. 10 Lakhs.
2. Mental wellness lounge and dedicated counselor on campus.
3. Better inter-department sports facilities and annual college fest revival.
4. Placement bootcamps with industry leaders.

candidate_applications.biography: 3rd Year Mechanical Engineering, Captain of SAE Formula Racing Team.
candidate_applications.manifesto:
1. State-of-the-art makerspace and 3D printing access for all departments.
2. Equal budget allocation for cultural and technical clubs.
3. Electric shuttle service inside campus grounds.
